overview_description.description: xAI develops frontier artificial intelligence models and products focused on reasoning, search, and multimodal interaction. The company offers Grok, an AI assistant available on web and mobile that supports chat, code generation, real-time web and X search, vision, file analysis, image and video generation, and voice conversations. xAI provides a unified API for text, code, images, video, and voice, along with SDKs and compatibility with other ecosystems so developers can integrate its models into applications. It delivers Grok Business and enterprise solutions with connectors to workplace tools, document processing, office add-ins, and governance features for organizations. xAI also operates Colossus, its large-scale compute infrastructure used to train and serve Grok model families and related capabilities.
